Breadcrumb Schema Generator

Build BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema from your page's breadcrumb trail.





  
  


  

    

      
📖 How to use

      
  1. Enter each breadcrumb label and its URL, from home onward.
  2. Click Add Crumb for each level.
  3. Reorder by removing and re-adding if needed.
  4. Generate, copy and paste the JSON-LD into your page.

    

    

      
❓ Frequently asked questions

      
How do I build the trail?
Add each crumb with its label and URL, in order from home to the current page. The tool numbers positions automatically.
What position numbers are used?
Positions start at 1 for the home page and increment — the generator handles this.
Should the current page be included?
The last crumb is the current page — it still gets a position and URL in the list.
How do I use the output?
Copy the JSON-LD into your page <head> and validate with Google's Rich Results Test.
